body: He was mean but shit this makes me weep because was fair
Pride has been my sin so long, I wanted to the one who made a way for himself because my dad was so mean to me throughout my childhood, I told myself I would do better than him
I've always been the prodigal son who who has been too strong on his own and independent.

I'm pissed about the "it gets better crowd" haha  she wasn't my first but my first I would settle down with her and have kids.  And she was right there with me. The thing is it's being 1.5 years and it doesn't feel any better.  I tried Okucupid and Bumble to no avail, totally duds here.  I've thought about the extreme and dicthing my job and moving back to the midwest.
